_comment: Dual-title / eyebrow architecture. Per edition: 'eyebrow' = a clean operational category (rendered uppercase, accent) shown ABOVE the creative title; 'subtitle' = a concrete plain-English descriptor of what the brief is actually about, shown UNDER the title. *_fr are careful human-quality French translations. Grounded in each edition's fact-checked content — no new claims. Consumed by scripts/card_meta.py (landing feed cards, EN) and scripts/edition_hero.py (edition pages, EN kicker+subtitle and FR kicker+subtitle). Add an entry when a new edition ships, then re-run both scripts.
